extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: microcar (bubble car with front door), approx. 2.5 x 1.4 x 1.4 m (L x W x H), wheel diameter 0.52 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); the whole front is a door (microcar_front_door) with its own windshield (microcar_door_windows, child of the door), origin on the vertical hinge on the right side, rotate around local Z to open; hollow body with bench seat and steering wheel; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
